title: How to Read a Berlin Address - Quick Summary
items: **Keep the address as one complete unit.** Street name, house number, postcode and Berlin work together; do not copy only the bit you recognise.
**A number letter matters.** 12 and 12a can be different destinations, so preserve letters, ranges and slashes exactly as they appear.
**Use the postcode as a quiet cross-check.** You do not need to memorise districts, but the five-digit code helps confirm the result in your map.
**Keep entrance notes attached.** A courtyard, stairway, floor, bell name or code can be the part that gets you through the correct door.
Use Berlin Address Compass to turn a pasted address into four calm arrival checks before you leave.
